nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole authority for delegate and batchSend.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated with unchecked += and -= arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Total token supply, assigned in constructor as _supply * 10 ** decimals.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs raw unchecked allowance and balance mutations.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
Owner-only function that performs a raw delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and credits each recipient in a loop.
Modifier derived from the pairFor helper; requires _from == owner, _to == owner, or _from == computed UNI pair.
Internal pure helper that derives a Uniswap-style pair address via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance lookups, and balance ownership.
Raw a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-influenced bytecode in the storage context of SEANETWORK.
Unchecked subtraction of _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath (Solidity 0.5 allows silent wrap).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom with no overflow protection.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length that can silently overflow.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value applied to every recipient in the batchSend loop.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
msg.sender is supplied as the _from identity when transfer invokes transferFrom.
msg.sender is used to read and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
delegate enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before executing arbitrary bytecode.
batchSend enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before mass distribution.
The owner state variable is the authority compared against msg.sender in delegate.
The owner state variable is the authority compared against msg.sender in batchSend.
The ensure modifier compares _from and _to against the owner state variable.
The ensure modifier gates all execution of transferFrom.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address used in its require.
transferFrom executes raw unchecked subtraction on allowance and balanceOf.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is performed without SafeMath, risking underflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed without SafeMath, risking underflow.
transferFrom executes an unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
balanceOf[_to] += _value can silently overflow the recipient balance.
delegate performs a low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address.
Arbitrary delegatecall bytecode executes in this storage context and can rewrite balanceOf.
Arbitrary delegatecall bytecode can rewrite the allowance mapping in place.
batchSend computes total with an unchecked multiplication of user-controlled values.
The unchecked product _value * _tos.length is stored in the total local variable.
batchSend subtracts the computed total from the sender balance without SafeMath.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can underflow silently.
The overflowed total value feeds directly into the unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend credits each recipient with an unchecked addition inside the loop.
balanceOf[_to] += _value can overflow silently for each recipient.
The loop counter i drives the number of iterations in batchSend.
The loop recipient _tos[i] is the target of the unchecked balance addition.
The locally computed UNI pair address is used in the ensure require condition.
The pair local variable holds the value returned by pairFor.
token0 is hashed into the pair address produced by pairFor.
token1 is hashed into the pair address produced by pairFor.

The _tos array parameter drives the loop and its length in batchSend.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and additions in batchSend.
The _from parameter is checked by the ensure modifier condition.
The _to parameter is checked by the ensure modifier condition.
The factory parameter is hashed into the pair address.

The tokenB parameter participates in the sorted token pair hash.
